title: Live-rendering Markdown composer
description: Type Markdown in the takeover composer — bold, lists, headings and code blocks render while you type, with syntax markers folding away once the cursor leaves the line.

title: Render mode vs source mode
description: The same message in render mode (markers folded, real styles) and source mode (every marker visible). One toggle switches between them.

title: Rich-text paste conversion
description: Pasting rich text from a webpage converts the clipboard text/html to clean Markdown at the caret.

title: Markdown-rendered user messages
description: Sent user messages render as Markdown — headings, lists and syntax-highlighted code blocks — instead of a wall of plain text.
